To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have demonstrated a new method of selectively measuring atmospheric HO2 and/or RO2 using chemical amplification coupled with a denuder.
the PERCA-LIFE technique coupled to a denudation pre-inlet allows the selective measurement of the sum of HO 2 + RO 2 in the atmosphere.
we have demonstrated a technique for the selective removal of HO 2 relative to RO 2 in air samples.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development and use of a new technique for selective measurements of atmospheric peroxy radicals, HO2 and RO 1, using chemical amplification and laser-induced fluorescence (LIF) detection (PERCA LIF).
the measurement and modeling of atmospheric peroxy radicals.
the development of a new technique for the measurement of atmospheric peroxygen radical concentrations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the PERCA-LF technique is a powerful tool for the measurement of atmospheric HO 2 and HO 2 +RO 2.
the denuding method is a very powerful technique to selectively measure atmospheric HO2 and/or RO2.
the PERCA-LIFO2 denuder technique is a powerful and versatile method to measure HO2 and RO 1 in the atmosphere.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we developed a method for selective measurement of peroxy radicals.
the PERCA-LAF coupled with a denuding technique is a powerful tool for the measurement of atmospheric HO 2 and HO 2 + RO 2 concentrations.
the PERCA-LAF method coupled to a denuding method is a powerful tool for measuring HO2 and RO  concentrations in the troposphere.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is now possible to selectively measure HO2 and RO 1.
the denuder technique is very effective at removing HO2 and RO 1, and the PERCA-Lif instrument is very effective at measuring RO 2.
a new method for selective HO 2 and HO 2 + RO 2 measurements has been developed.
